summary.zh: 逐条追问方案，直到理解完全对齐
summary.en: Interview you one question at a time to stress-test a plan.

description.zh: 针对一个方案或设计连续发问，每轮只问一个问题并附上推荐答案，把决策树上的分支逐个走完。适合上线前压力测试、找出设计盲点时使用。能靠读代码回答的问题会先去查。
description.en: Interviews you about a plan or design, one question per turn with a recommended answer, working each branch until nothing is ambiguous. Use it to stress-test a plan before building; anything the codebase can answer is looked up, not asked.
